meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use 999 (or any value ≥ 500) for max to mean no practical upper bound in the matcher.

general.description: Chemosynthetic and thermosynthetic extremophile organisms that grow on fumaroles and volcanic vents. They derive energy from geothermal activity and often incorporate mineral deposits from vent ejecta, giving them semi-inorganic appearances.

planet_requirements.atmosphere_note: Any thin atmosphere is acceptable; matcher uses surface pressure (thin) only — not AtmosphereType.

environmental_context: Found directly on fumaroles and gas vent structures
Often appear in clusters on flat volcanic terrain
Require active geothermal heat sources to sustain metabolism

species.description: Water-volcanism adapted variant forming dark clustered folds that trap geothermal heat.

matchContextNotes: Codex: spawns on fumarole / vent sites. Species split by water-class volcanism (journal substring: water).
Thin atmosphere = pressure gate only; composition can be e.g. sulphur dioxide.
Variant colour follows planetary rare materials (genus meta), not star class.

species.description: Thin tubular structures adapted to carbon and methane volcanic emissions.

matchContextNotes: Codex: carbon dioxide / methane class volcanism — journal text usually contains carbon or methane.
Variant colour follows planetary rare materials (genus meta), not star class.

species.description: Highly adaptive variant found on silicate, iron, and rocky volcanism zones. Exhibits strong environmental plasticity.

matchContextNotes: Codex: silicate / iron / rocky volcanism wording in journal.
Variant colour follows planetary rare materials (genus meta), not star class.

species.description: Ovoid nitrogen-based variant with dotted surface markings, optimized for nitrogen/ammonia vents.

matchContextNotes: Codex: nitrogen or ammonia class volcanism in journal text.
Variant colour follows planetary rare materials (genus meta), not star class.

special_rules: Thin atmosphere via pressure (atmospherePressureCategory) — not a specific AtmosphereType
Fumarole geological signal is mandatory spawn condition in matcher when body has DSS/FSS hints
Volcanism type is the primary species driver (substring on journal Volcanism)
Color is determined by local rare materials, not star class
Minimum sample distance is 100m due to dense clustering
All species are strongly dependent on active geothermal activity
